title: DNA Cleanup Using SPRIselect Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: Beads are left to incubate for 5 minutes
Supernatant is removed and disposed of
Samples are left to elute for 2 minutes

steps.title: Mix SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Vortex or invert the SPRIselect beads to ensure they are homogeneous before use.

steps.title: Add beads to samples and mix
steps.instruction: Add 126 µL of the mixed SPRI beads to each sample and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes to allow DNA binding to the beads.

steps.title: Separate beads with magnet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to collect the beads against the well surface.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol (twice)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of ethanol to the beads, then remove and discard the ethanol; repeat this wash a second time.

steps.title: Disengage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Turn off or remove the magnetic module to release the beads.

steps.title: Add elution buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 101 µL of elution solution to each sample and mix to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 2 minutes at room temperature to elute DNA from the beads.

steps.title: Separate beads again
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to pull the beads to the side.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of the cleared eluate and transfer it to column 2 of the 96‑well plate.
